factions.name: Lightbearer
factions.description: Heroes who serve in the name of Dura, dedicated to freeing the land of Esperia from evil; hold a factional advantage over Maulers but are weak against Graveborn.

factions.name: Mauler
factions.description: A warrior culture that believes strength is everything, judging worth purely by might and usability; hold a factional advantage over Wilders.

factions.name: Wilder
factions.description: Heroes who serve and protect Nature, also battling Hypogeans to keep them from the homeland and Yggdrasil; hold a factional advantage over Graveborn.

factions.name: Graveborn
factions.description: Heroes who serve Death, revived as the Undead and seeking immortality through dark arts and necromancy; hold a factional advantage over Lightbearers.

factions.name: Celestial
factions.description: Heroes who serve directly under Dura, standing opposite the Hypogeans in a mutual factional rivalry.

factions.name: Hypogean
factions.description: The game's primary antagonist faction, bent on unraveling everything Dura created and spreading evil across Esperia.

cards.name: Lucius
cards.description: Known as the 'Shield Grandpa'; a strength-based Tank/Support hybrid who stalls enemies in melee while shielding and healing allies.

cards.name: Belinda
cards.description: Intelligence-based mage with one of the best base crit ratings in the game; her Divine Light ultimate hits a wide area four times.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.description: Throws gold coins onto the battlefield that heal and empower allies who collect them while stunning enemies who do; a flexible early-to-endgame buffer.

cards.name: Brutus
cards.description: Strength-based Mauler tank who becomes immune to mind control while spinning in a frenzy; deals more damage the lower his own health falls.

cards.name: Skreg
cards.description: 'The Cunning'; rides his iron-jaw steed to become immune to knockback and crowd control while his attacks strike twice and knock enemies down.

cards.name: Numisu
cards.description: A witch doctor who summons totems that heal and taunt while burst-healing two allies with his ultimate.

cards.name: Nemora
cards.description: The Wilders' premier healer, channeling nature's forces to mend her team and even charm enemies into attacking each other.

cards.name: Eironn
cards.description: 'Stormsword'; a dual-blade ranger whose ultimate deals heavy damage before summoning an ice tornado that knocks back and slows enemies.

cards.name: Lyca
cards.description: Opens fights by inspiring allies with a Haste and energy boost, then fires a powerful knockback arrow; renowned for enabling fast team pushes.

cards.name: Shemira
cards.description: 'The Corpsemaker'; a highly durable mage who sacrifices her own health to deal continuous AoE damage and heal herself through life drain.

cards.name: Ferael
cards.description: 'Doomwhisper'; fires demonic arrows that hit the whole enemy team and summons spirits that drain enemy energy to delay their ultimates.

cards.name: Baden
cards.description: A 'snowball' hero who spawns near-identical phantom clones of himself that fight and ultimate independently, growing stronger the longer he survives.

cards.name: Talene
cards.description: Transforms into a phoenix to convert her health into a shield, revives herself in battle, and can also unleash meteorites for damage.

cards.name: Athalia
cards.description: 'Harbinger of Justice'; a lightning-fast blade dancer whose triple-slash ultimate always crits on the final hit, with damage reduction scaling to her surviving allies.

cards.name: Flora
cards.description: A continuous-damage mage who floods the densest cluster of enemies with a magical sea of flowers while rejuvenating her own health.

cards.name: Ezizh
cards.description: 'Lord of Nightmares'; a Hypogean support who mind-controls an enemy, silences enemy ultimates with a shockwave, and empowers his own team's energy regen.

cards.name: Envydiel
cards.description: 'Venomous Desire'; an Awakened agility ranger who marks the enemy's strongest attacker, steals healing aimed at that mark, and unleashes an enhanced, silencing strike.

cards.name: Mortas
cards.description: Steals health from enemies with every normal attack and channels it into empowering his team's top damage dealer with extra Attack Rating and Attack Speed.
